purpose: Reference-image inventory and per-shot anchor map for the LOCAL open-weight rebuild of the 43s Peshta reel (still-per-scene -> image-to-video -> mux existing master music). Model-agnostic: describes WHAT each shot must contain, not how to prompt any model.
source_of_shot_windows: FINAL_RECREATION_REPORT section 3 (11 macro shots); choreography detail from driving_clips/SHOT_TABLE.md
critical_caveat_two_disjoint_casts: The library contains TWO mutually incompatible casts. TRACK A (character_assets/polat_*, elif_*) is the likeness cast named in the 11 macro shots, but the assets are neutral studio portraits. TRACK B (05_build/keys/S-A*, S-B*, REF_M1, REF_F1) is a deliberately IP-safe original cast ('Kemal Yalcin' / 'Nergis') built for a separate native rebuild; the FACES ARE DIFFERENT PEOPLE, but its SETS and PALETTE are the closest thing in the repository to the Peshta original: SET_A is the red-orange cyclorama with red-carpeted risers, matte orange foam blocks and a corps in black floor-length dresses and black wide-brim hats (matches shots 01-07, 10, 11); SET_B is the sand quarry with freestanding red gate frames, red blocks and a white-suited white-masked corps (matches shots 08-09). Use Track A for identity and Track B for set/style, and expect the mix to need reconciling.
global_gaps: WARDROBE IS UNANCHORED. In the driving footage the male lead wears a dark green military dress tunic with gold epaulettes, a gold aiguillette, a dense medal rack, a red sash and a cream wide-brim fedora; the female lead wears a white sleeveless dress with pearl ropes and a pearl-studded white net head veil. NOT ONE of the 71 reference images shows either costume. Track A dresses him in a plain black suit (or the navy canyon jacket) and her in cream knitwear; Track B dresses him in a black wool frock coat and her in an ivory column gown. Every keyframe will have to invent the costume from text.

NO RED PYRAMID. Shots 01, 03, 06 and 11 all stand the lead on a tall five-riser red-carpeted pyramid. Track B's rostrum is three low broad risers and Track A has no steps at all except elif_seated_red_steps. Nothing anchors the pyramid's height or proportions.
NO ENSEMBLE MOTION. All three corps images (S-A08, S-A09, S-A13) are static symmetric formations. The reel's corps is scattered, asymmetric and mid-bounce throughout.

TRACK A FEMALE IDENTITY IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT. elif_closeup, elif_medium_shot and elif_master_split_sheet do not read as the same woman; pick ONE and discard the others before generating, or the local model will drift shot to shot.

cards/*.png are Uzbek caption overlay graphics (text in a dark pill on an empty canvas). They carry no scene or identity information and are useless as style anchors; they belong to the caption compositor, not the image pipeline.
dedup_note: 05_build/keys/ holds 52 PNG files but only 35 unique images by md5: each canonical S-*.png is a byte-identical copy of its winning attempt (S-A01<=a01, S-A07<=a02, S-A10<=a02, S-A12<=a02, S-A13<=a02, S-B01<=a02, S-B03<=a01, S-A14<=a01, S-A04<=a01, S-A05<=a01, S-A08<=a01, S-A09<=a01=a02, S-A11<=a01=e02; S-B02 alone differs, being the border-cropped repair of S-B02_a01). 05_build/build/cover_frame0.jpg is a JPEG of S-A01. Feed the canonical names only.
viewing_method: Every character_assets file (9/9), every canonical 05_build/keys scene key (16/16 incl. REF_M1/REF_F1), 4 representative _aNN/_eNN variants, AUD_M1_1, AUD_F1_1, cover_frame0.jpg and cards/c1.png were opened and looked at (33 of 71). The remaining 38 are the 6 unviewed AUD frames, 24 unviewed S-*_aNN/_eNN attempt siblings and 8 unviewed caption cards; their descriptions are marked viewed:false and are inferred from filename plus 05_build/CASTING.md, CASTING_GATE4.md and cards/strings.txt.

shot_to_anchor_map.action: Elif smartphone-surprise reaction cutting to the male lead's wrist flourishes atop the red pyramid steps.
shot_to_anchor_map.composition_from_driving_still: WIDE. Male lead full-length, centred, standing on the top riser of a five-step red-carpeted pyramid that fills the lower third; four black-dressed, black-wide-brim-hatted dancers flank at mid-distance left and right, arms extended; monochrome red-orange cyclorama, orange floor, matte orange blocks at the edges.
shot_to_anchor_map.note: Identity is covered full-length (Track A) and the set is covered by S-A13 (lead centred on a red riser with flanking hatted banks). Gap: S-A13 is a symmetric corridor, not a five-step pyramid, and no image anywhere shows the pyramid.

shot_to_anchor_map.action: Male lead in a white fedora leaning charismatically toward the female lead seated with red roses on the red velvet steps.
shot_to_anchor_map.composition_from_driving_still: TWO-SHOT, medium. She sits low frame-left in a white dress and pearl-studded veil, an armful of red roses across her lap; he sits/leans one step higher frame-right in a dark military dress tunic with gold epaulettes and a cream wide-brim fedora, hand on hip. Red risers, red surround. NOTE: the driving frame is a vertical triptych with letterboxed inset strips top and bottom.
shot_to_anchor_map.note: S-A12 is the only two-shot in the entire library and it matches almost beat for beat: pair seated on the red rostrum, dark red flowers across her lap, he turns to her. elif_seated_red_steps supplies the same pose in Track A's own cast.

shot_to_anchor_map.action: THE 0:34 beat drop: male lead drops into a deep squat bounce while the corps snaps into synchronized knee bounces.
shot_to_anchor_map.composition_from_driving_still: HERO WIDE with ensemble. Male lead centre, knees bent wide in a deep squat, head dropped so the cream fedora brim hides the face, gold epaulettes catching the key; eight hatted dancers scattered asymmetrically in depth on both sides and below; a raised red block platform under him, red cyclorama.
shot_to_anchor_map.note: NO GOOD ANCHOR for the composition. Every corps image in the library is a static formation (S-A09 lateral bank, S-A13 mirrored corridor, S-A08 floor-level hems) — none shows a lead mid-squat with a scattered, non-symmetric ensemble, and none shows the raised red block platform. Identity is covered; set/action is not.

shot_to_anchor_map.action: Elif profile glance clutching pearls, cutting to the male lead's sharp alternating shoulder pops.
shot_to_anchor_map.composition_from_driving_still: MCU, tight.
